data.name: Ghazia
data.gender_notes: Ghazia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'ghaz', meaning 'to fight, strive or raid'. In Islamic history, Ghazis were warriors who fought in defense of Islam or for the expansion of Muslim territories. This name embodies the spirit of courage, determination, and sacrifice. The name Ghazia carries the meaning “Warrior, Fighter for Cause” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghazia usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior, fighter for cause and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the courageous Ghazis, who fought for the cause of Islam.
data.etymology: Ghazia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warrior, Fighter for Cause.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghazia total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
